items.source: NOTE: The MergedAnnotations API and its underlying model have been designed for composable annotations in Spring's common component model, with a focus on attribute aliasing and meta-annotation relationships. There is no support for retrieving plain Java annotations with this API; please use standard Java reflection or Spring's AnnotationUtils for simple annotation retrieval purposes.
items.translation: 注意：MergedAnnotations API 及其底层模型是为 Spring 通用组件模型中的可组合注解而设计的，重点在于属性别名和元注解关系。该 API 不支持检索普通的 Java 注解；请用于简单的注解检索目的时，使用标准的 Java 反射或 Spring 的 AnnotationUtils。

items.source: The resulting instance will not include any inherited annotations. If you want to include those as well you should use from(AnnotatedElement, SearchStrategy) with an appropriate MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy.

items.source: The resulting stream is ordered first by the aggregate index and then by the annotation distance (with the closest annotations first). This ordering means that, for most use-cases, the most suitable annotations appear earliest in the stream.
items.translation: 生成的流首先按聚合索引排序，然后按注释距离排序（最近的注释排在前面）。此排序方式意味着，对于大多数用例，最合适的注释会出现在流的最前面。
